scenes.say: Only one percent of people get this right. Can you?
Three apples make thirty. Two bananas and an apple make eighteen. Two grapes and a banana make ten. So what is grape, plus apple, times banana?
The answer is forty three! An apple is ten, a banana is four, and a grape is three. Multiply first: ten times four is forty, plus three is forty three. Did you say fifty two?
Comment what you got, and follow for a new brain teaser every day.
